attchmntText: Sarthak Metals Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Sarthak Metals Limited filed its Q2 FY2026-2027 earnings presentation with the BSE and NSE on 15th November 2026. Revenue from operations rose 44% year-on-year to Rs 52.37 crore. EBITDA margin improved 146 basis points sequentially to 4.27%. Profit after tax was Rs 1.28 crore, compared to Rs 0.76 crore in Q2 FY2025-2026. Earnings per share stood at Rs 0.92. Cored wire volumes increased 37% year-on-year to 1,463 tonnes. Welding division revenue grew 49% year-on-year to Rs 5.6 crore. Aluminium flipping coil volumes decreased 13% year-on-year to 156 tonnes. Short-term borrowings reduced to Rs 2.6 crore from Rs 6.6 crore in March 2026. Operating cash flow generated was Rs 4.1 crore. The company aims for Rs 25 crore annual sales in the welding segment for FY27.

attchmntText: Sarthak Metals Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Sarthak Metals Limited filed a notice regarding the publication of un-audited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended 30th September 2026. The company published the results in the Financial Express and Shram Bindu newspapers on 14th November 2026. The filing was submitted to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited. Pratik Jain, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, signed the letter on behalf of the company.

attchmntText: Sarthak Metals Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Sarthak Metals Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board appointed Mr. Sarthak Bansal as Chief Financial Officer. Revenue from operations for the quarter ended 30th September 2026 was Rs. 5236.57 Lakhs, compared to Rs. 3630.76 Lakhs in the same period last year. Profit for the period was Rs. 127.75 Lakhs, versus Rs. 75.91 Lakhs previously. Total assets stood at Rs. 13332.16 Lakhs as of 30th September 2026. The company reported Rs. 1.76 Lac in unrealized gains on foreign currency transactions. Mr. Bansal holds a Bachelor of Technology in Civil Engineering from VIT University, Chennai.
